chunks: And from him, from Sa'd, from Ahmad ibn Muhammad ibn 'Isa, from al-'Abbas ibn Musa al-Warraq, from Yunus, from 'Isa ibn Sulayman, from Muhammad ibn Ziyad, from his aunt, who said: I heard Abu 'Abdillah (peace be upon him) say:
Verily, in the clay of the Hā'ir, where al-Husayn (peace be upon him) is buried, there is a cure for every disease and protection from every fear.

key_terms.الْحَائِر: Al-Hā'ir, a specific region in Iraq where Imam Husayn is buried

ai.seo_question: What is the spiritual significance of the clay from the grave of Imam Husayn (a.s.)?
ai.summary: Recorded in Ibn Qulawayh’s *Kamil al-Ziyarat*, this hadith underscores the Shia belief in the tangible spiritual efficacy of the soil from Imam al-Husayn’s grave in Karbala’s Hā’ir region. It serves as a foundational text for the practice of using this clay (*turab*) for healing (*shifa*) and protection (*aman*), linking the physical site of the martyrdom to divine mercy and the intercessory status of the Ahl al-Bayt.
